parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the custom module in the Thing Specification Language model. The identifier is unique within the product.

If PropertyIdentifier.N, ServiceIdentifier.N, or EventIdentifier.N is not empty, specify this parameter to delete the specified features from the custom module. If this parameter is not specified, the specified features are deleted from the default module.

If PropertyIdentifier.N, ServiceIdentifier.N, and EventIdentifier.N are all empty, specify this parameter to delete the module and all feature definitions within it
parameters.help_zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

PropertyIdentifier.N、ServiceIdentifier.N或EventIdentifier.N不为空时，传入此参数，删除自定义模块下指定功能；不传入此参数，删除默认模块下指定功能。

PropertyIdentifier.N、ServiceIdentifier.N和EventIdentifier.N都为空时，传入此参数，删除该模块及其下所有功能定义
parameters.name: function_block_id
